test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'UPSIDE' is coded as 'NJNEAC' and 'GINGER' is coded as 'ZCICBP'. How will 'BRUNCH' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (7), (6), (5), (4), (3) and (2) are subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series starting with the first letter in the given word respectively.

So,

 
• 'UPSIDE' is coded as 'NJNEAC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a67ffcf48c659ca4f8ae2bf4c58633903191c9548a48f74a5c1911394fb1490.png] 

And,

 
• 'GINGER' is coded as 'ZCICBP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da00f9f5cd6bded6d8c0a510c09077124af8083b0095a627d1c18988b6477f04.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'BRUNCH' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c5c152fcc62cc8ed086ff28797ae8a74c30ee5c1dd4ba03fc0fd83262a85079.png] 

​Hence, "**ULPJZF**" is the correct answer.
